description: Convert text frames' text to outlines (compound paths), replacing the text or keeping it (Type > Create Outlines)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true: text frames

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)
